integrity: Proof uses explicit join--meet constructions and Frobenius fixed-point obstruction. Exact finite checks are supporting only; no computer experiment is presented as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Desarguesian PG(2,q), q a proper prime-power extension, point individualization, sorted incidence graph; stable singleton loci for frame-containing marks and global minimal mark count. No claim about non-singleton stable classes, exact rounds, or mixed point-line marks. Independent priority review not performed.
title: A subfield criterion and five-point individualization threshold for projective-plane colour refinement
